privacy_policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_policy.paragraph: This privacy policy applies to the Tournaments app (hereby referred to as "Application") for mobile devices that was created by Heriberto Rodriguez (hereby referred to as "Service Provider") as a Free service. This service is intended for use "AS IS".
privacy_policy.information_collection_and_use_paragraph: The Application collects information when you download and use it. This information may include:
privacy_policy.information_collection_and_use_point_one: Your device's Internet Protocol address (e.g. IP address)
privacy_policy.information_collection_and_use_point_two: The pages of the Application that you visit
privacy_policy.information_collection_and_use_point_thr: The operating system you use on your mobile device
